description: Deletes ONE participant question from the live console for good. Side effect: the question and its thread are removed from the site and cannot be brought back; no email is sent. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id`, `question_id` from wi_get_webinar_questions, and a clear yes (`confirm` true). To remove a whole set use wi_delete_all_webinar_questions.

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that this question may be deleted.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_delete_webinar_question
title: Delete one participant question
